🐾 Stepping back to see the themes, at **RBC**, Matt played a pivotal role in several modernization and strategic initiatives. He assessed the legacy infrastructure of **RBC**'s corporate banking platform, which lacked mobile capabilities and API integration, and provided a clear implementation roadmap for mobile adoption. This included designing API integration architecture and defining mobile capability requirements, which aligned **RBC**'s mobile-first strategy with customer expectations.

In another engagement, Matt addressed **RBC**'s data visibility limitations by designing a solution that extended transaction history access beyond the 180-day limit. This involved defining reporting requirements and designing scheduled report generation, which improved audit-readiness and financial planning for **RBC**'s clients.

Matt also conducted a rigorous architecture assessment for **RBC**'s corporate banking systems, which were struggling with performance and scalability. He evaluated the Bottomline WebSeries as a potential payment hub engine and identified that it couldn't meet **RBC**'s requirements. This assessment prevented a costly investment and allowed **RBC** to redirect resources to higher-priority initiatives.

Additionally, Matt led the data conversion planning for **RBC**'s Day**2Day** modernization, developing an end-to-end migration plan from the legacy **RBC** Express platform to Bottomline WebSeries. He ensured data integrity and compliance through the migration process.

Furthermore, Matt designed cross-border payment workflows for **RBC** Express, integrating real-time FX tools and automated alerts to improve operational efficiency and client satisfaction. He also established the PMO for **RBC**'s commercial banking modernization, developing a governance structure that provided visibility and coordination across all workstreams, enabling predictable execution and strategic alignment.
